`final class NodeMouseEvent<N extends Node>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`NodeInputEvent<N>`](/reference/events/nodeinputevent/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event.impl.node` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [NodeMouseEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/impl/node/NodeMouseEvent.java)

The event of a press, a release, a drag or a click on a node, with the position of the pointer and the button.

## Description

[`Node.onClick`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-event-onClick), [`Node.handleMousePressed`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-method-handleMousePressed), [`Node.handleMouseReleased`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-method-handleMouseReleased) and [`Node.handleMouseDragged`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-method-handleMouseDragged) receive it.
A `handle` listener hears every press of the UI, wherever the pointer is: test [`Node.isHovered`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-method-isHovered) to keep the presses on the node.

## Creation details

<a id="NodeMouseEvent-factory-create"></a>

### create

`<N extends Node> NodeMouseEvent<N> create(N node, double mouseX, double mouseY, MouseButton button, long deltaTime, IConsumableEvent source)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Creates the event for a node, the position of the pointer, the button and the time since the press.
`source` is the input that the event belongs to, or `null` for an input of its own.

<a id="NodeMouseEvent-method-getDeltaTime"></a>

### getDeltaTime

`long getDeltaTime()` 

Returns, for a drag or a release, the time in ms since the button went down (`0` for a release whose press JOID did not see); `0` for a press or a click.

<a id="NodeMouseEvent-method-getButton"></a>

### getButton

`MouseButton getButton()` 

Returns the [`MouseButton`](/reference/input/mousebutton/) of the event; for a drag, the button held.
